{{Top|leg}}
A '''molecular sifter''' was a type of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool. Used in conjunction with [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrills]] and automated [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]], molecular sifters allowed [[Miner/Legends|miners]] to extract precious metals faster.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
